message: B0 setup check: a spoofed Teague send is already in the Sent folder

() => { /* Finish (by selector: recap lines can contain the word) */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const b = mg && mg.container && mg.container.querySelector('.aw-finish'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; }
